//: Story Phase 4, chapter 17: The Center Picks the Worst Places. Days 4 to 6. A montage (powder store in the hold, medicine cabinet in the crew quarters, the galley oven), the captain's serious beard wash in the washroom (the tub at (7,5)), then Squawks's seven feathers in the captain's cabin: Squawks beside his perch (11,6), the Center rolling in from the stern windows, the only way out the door (8,11).

p4c3.begin.sub: The Center Picks the Worst Places

p4c3.begin.narrate: By now the crew are exhausted. And the Dead Center has developed a talent.

p4c3.montage_powder: brask[annoyed]: Gunnery drill, Captain. The powder's in the store. The store's in the Center.
brask[annoyed]: Every drill this week. It KNOWS.
p4c3.montage_medicine: wick[sad]: It's only a little splinter. It's a big little splinter.
fennimore[concerned]: The tweezers are in the cabinet, Wick. The cabinet is in the Center.
wick[sad]: ...Can I just keep it, then?
p4c3.montage_bread: jim[sad]: Fresh bread, Captain. First in a week. Proper crust on it. Smell that—
jim[alarmed]: No. Don't smell that. It's in the Center.
p4c3.resolve: The powder store at gunnery drill. The medicine cabinet during a splinter. The oven the moment there was bread.
It's never in the wrong place. It's never somewhere nobody needs. It is, the crew have started saying, the only thing on this ship that's always exactly where it's meant to be.
captain[determined]: That's it. There is ONE thing aboard this ship I can still fix myself.

p4c3.resolve.tutorial: Try one more serious beard wash, in the Washroom (below, off the Crew Quarters). Use the tub.
p4c3.resolve.title: The Worst Places

p4c3.beard_wash: The tub. The basin. The shelf of everything you have ever tried.
captain[determined]: Right. All of it. At once.
Seawater first. Then soap, a whole cake of it. Then two lemons, squeezed. A cup of vinegar. A fistful of sand for scouring.
Then a smouldering bundle of Doc Fennimore's herbs, waved underneath, for the smoke.
You scrub until your arms ache. You scrub until the beard squeaks. For one wonderful moment, you think you can smell lemon.

p4c3.beard_wash.narrate: It comes in through the vent and passes through the washroom like a warm, yellow, unhurried tide.
It does not stop. It does not need to.

p4c3.beard_wash: When you can see again, the Grand Stenchmaster is standing in the doorway, at a respectful distance, holding a handkerchief.
garrick[delighted]: Oh, Captain. It's been REFRESHED.
garrick[businesslike]: Concentrated re-exposure, straight into a freshly scrubbed beard. You opened up every hair and then let the Center walk in and sit down.
garrick[proud]: That's more years on the lifespan, Captain. Several. Possibly a decade.
Somewhere up on deck, a gull falls out of the rigging.
garrick[businesslike]: I'll put it in the log.

p4c3.beard_wash.tutorial: Garrick has updated the Stench Log. Read what he wrote about your beard (the Stench Log stand at his station, midships).
p4c3.beard_wash.title: The Worst Places

p4c3.beard_log: captain[angry]: I do not approve this wording.
He takes out a crayon and adds a line underneath, in very large letters.
garrick[smug]: There. 'Captain does not approve.' Now it's accurate AND complete.

p4c3.feathers_begin.narrate: One thing aboard has been going well.

p4c3.feathers_begin: wick[happy]: That's Squawks, Captain. He's been counting them all morning. He keeps losing count after three.

p4c3.feathers_begin.tutorial: Squawks is in your cabin, by his perch. He wants you to count his feathers.
p4c3.feathers_begin.title: Seven Feathers

p4c3.feathers_count: He puffs out his chest. There, among the pink, are feathers. Real ones. A bit of green, a bit of red, and on top, the golden one.
squawks[smug]: SEVEN! Squawks has SEVEN! Squawks is a BIRD again!
You are, you realise, genuinely delighted. You haven't been genuinely delighted about anything in a week.
squawks[smug]: Soon Squawks has EIGHT. Then a HUNDRED.
Behind the stern windows, the light turns yellow.
squawks[horrified]: SAVE FEATHERS! SAVE FEATHERS! SAVE FEATHERS!
You tuck him inside your coat, all seven feathers and the blanket too, and button it up to your chin.

p4c3.feathers_count.tutorial: Get Squawks out of the cabin (the door, bottom middle) before the Center reaches you!
p4c3.feathers_count.title: Seven Feathers

p4c3.feathers_out: You come out of the cabin door at a run, and you don't stop until you're halfway to the mainmast.
A small voice comes from inside your coat.
hale: It's gone off, Captain. The cabin's clear. Or clear as anywhere is.

p4c3.feathers_out.tutorial: The cloud has left your cabin. Take Squawks back inside.
p4c3.feathers_out.title: Seven Feathers

p4c3.feathers_back: You unbutton your coat. Squawks climbs out and settles on the floor beside his perch, very carefully.
He twists round and counts them with his beak. One. Two. Three. Four. Five. Six. Seven.
It floats down past his foot and lands on the floor.
squawks[worried]: No. No no no. STAY.
The last four let go all at once, together, as if they'd talked it over and agreed.
You sit down on the cabin floor beside him, which you haven't done since you were a boy with your first ship's parrot, and you let him climb down onto your knee.
captain[tender]: They came back once. They'll come back again. You're a tough old bird.
garrick[businesslike]: Ah. A recurring molt. Very common in exposed birds. I'll note it as—
